findings.summary: Author lifespan formatting is duplicated outside the exported helper.
findings.consequence: Future changes to sentinel handling or year validation can drift between author profile pages, Dramawebben catalog labels, and library tooltip labels.
findings.evidence: The owned formatter builds the same birth/death/fallback string shape that also appears in the Dramawebben catalog author-year helper and library tooltip author text helper; those copies are not routed through this exported helper.
findings.recommendation: Move the visible-year normalization and lifespan formatting into one shared helper, then reuse it from the Dramawebben catalog and library tooltip code where the same domain label is produced.
